title: Resource Manifest
description: Fixed schema for verification/<task>/resource-manifest.json, aligned with the real manifest in the repository. Structural requirements are enforced; integrity fields and extra metadata are accepted as recorded.

schema_version.description: Only version 1 is accepted. A future version requires a new checker release.

task_id.description: Must equal the id of the Task whose section references this file.

resource_type.description: Free-form category, e.g. worktree, generated-build-artifacts, evidence.

source_path.description: Original expression exactly as recorded. Brace shorthand, %VARS% and globs may appear here and are NEVER expanded.

disposition.description: ALREADY_ABSENT is the only value permitted for a resource that was listed but whose target no longer exists. NOT_APPLICABLE means the resource never applied and must never be used for a vanished target.

destination_path.description: Original expression exactly as recorded. May hold prose such as 'Same source location'; the checker resolves it only when it is a plain resolvable path.

sha256.description: Optional. Recorded when the author could compute one; absence is not a defect.

manifest_path.description: Optional alternative to an inline sha256.

process_check.description: Reference / running-process check and its result. Required even for ALREADY_ABSENT, where it must state that no reference remains.

absent_evidence.description: ALREADY_ABSENT only: how it was established that the target no longer exists.

items.description: Unknown keys are tolerated rather than rejected: the only real manifest in the repository carries branch / base_commit / delivery_head on its worktree resource, and a schema that rejects accurate historical data is worse than useless.

closeout_counts.description: Every key must be a non-negative integer. These are DECLARED closeout totals, not a derived count: they may include actions on files that are not themselves listed in resources (P19-UI-FIX-1 declares moved=6 for six logs renamed inside its evidence directory, while all seven listed resources carry moved=false). The checker therefore records a difference between a declared count and the number of matching booleans in resources, but must NOT fail on it - judged against the real manifest, the stricter rule condemned an accurate third-party record.
